name: forge-nsh
description: NSH web workbench with an embedded Forge Core service

scripts.setup: git submodule update --init --recursive vendor/forge-core && pnpm -C vendor/forge-core install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -C vendor/forge-core build
scripts.build: pnpm -C vendor/forge-core build && nsh package App.tsx --target web --out dist/web
